card.name: Words just before a time span
card.fires_on: Small words or gaps right before a number and a unit of time, such as 'at least', 'just under', 'more than' or 'a', where a span of days, weeks or hours comes next.

modes.label: Quantity words before a duration
modes.description: Words like 'least', 'under' or 'than' that lead into a number of days, weeks or months.
modes.example: Stop biotin and biotin-containing supplements for at<< least>> 2 days prior to thyroid testing.

modes.label: Gap before a number and time unit
modes.description: The space or article right before a figure like 2 days, 1-week or 24-hour.
modes.example: Do not take more than 6 doses (12 inhalations) in a<< >>24-hour period.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word 'period' or 'periods' (and date or time-span words) after the coming duration.
card.plain: It fires on the words just before a length of time, like 'at least' before '2 days', and prepares the word 'period'.
